title: QROS shared definitions
description: FROZEN QROS 1.0 COPY, retired by QROS 2.0.0. Kept only so the retired v1 schemas beside it resolve their $ref targets as they did under v1. Never used for new work; the current shared definitions are schemas/common.schema.json. Original v1 description: Closed vocabularies and shared primitives referenced by the other QROS schemas. Enforces the vocabularies fixed by SPEC.md; defines no rule of its own. SPEC.md is the sole normative source.

Identifier.description: A durable identifier. Opaque to the schema; uniqueness is a project concern.

Digest.description: Lowercase hex content digest, 32-128 hex characters.

RoleBinding.description: Which concrete party filled a QROS role. Binding role to product is project configuration (QROS-ROLE-VENDOR-BINDING-IS-CONFIG); the schema constrains shape only, never vendor.

Lane.description: QROS-AXIS-LANE. Governs which claims work may emit, and nothing else.

ExposureLevel.description: QROS-AXIS-OUTCOME-EXPOSURE. UNKNOWN is treated as potentially exposed and is never simplified to NONE.

ExposureRecord.description: Exposure is a property of a PARTY with respect to a QUESTION or TARGET, never of an artifact globally (QROS-AXIS-OUTCOME-EXPOSURE). Both party and target are therefore required.

ReviewVerdict.description: QROS-REVIEW-VERDICTS. Exactly three values. A review that never became valid returned NO verdict and omits the field entirely; no sentinel value exists.

ReviewValidity.description: Template structural branch, not a verdict. VALID reviews carry a verdict; INVALID reviews carry none.

EvidenceClass.description: QROS-REVIEW-EVIDENCE-CLASSES. SELF_REPORTED is never blocking on its own (QROS-REVIEW-SELF-REPORTED-NOT-BLOCKING).

BaselineThreatClass.description: The six baseline classes of QROS-THREAT-VOCABULARY.

ThreatClass.$comment: Closed vocabulary (QROS-THREAT-VOCABULARY). A project may not add, remove, merge or rename a class. A concern that fits none of these is non-blocking and belongs in backlog, not in an extended vocabulary.
ThreatClass.description: One of the six threat classes. Closed.

BlockerClass.description: QROS-BLOCKER-CLASSES. Closed; only CURRENT_PATH_BLOCKER and ARCHITECTURE_LEVEL_BLOCKER hold a project.

IsolationMechanism.$comment: QROS-BLIND-IS-TRANSPORT: blindness is established by a separately constructed evidence surface, built outside the environment holding the material the reviewer must not reach, enumerated in advance and mechanically bounded. This is the mechanism, not one option among several; no alternative isolation architecture is recognised.
IsolationMechanism.description: The evidence-surface mechanism. Single permitted value.

BoundaryRecord.description: What was technically reachable, what the boundary excluded, and how that boundary was established and checked (QROS-BLIND-IS-TRANSPORT).

BaselineOwnerGate.description: The six reserved actions of QROS-OWNER-GATE-LIST. A project may add gates; it may not remove one.

OwnerGate.$comment: Closed list (QROS-OWNER-GATE-LIST). A project may not add, remove or rename a gate.
OwnerGate.description: One of the six reserved Owner actions. Closed.

LifecycleStage.description: QROS-LIFECYCLE-STAGES. A project may alias these names in configuration; the canonical set is closed.

IndependenceDimension.description: The four kinds of QROS-INDEP-FOUR-KINDS. Only EMPIRICAL_INDEPENDENCE supports a replication claim.

IndependenceStatement.description: Independence stated per dimension AND per target (QROS-INDEP-STATE-PER-DIMENSION). A statement without a target is not conforming, so target is required.
